# A raw: task carries no module payload, so Ansible's ssh plugin never
# takes the pipelined "Data could not be sent to remote host" lead - it
# reports the plain "Failed to connect to the host via ssh: <stderr>"
# regardless of this option. Pinned here so a shell that exports
# ANSIBLE_PIPELINING (this dev box does) cannot change either side.
ANSIBLE_PIPELINING=False
